_notes: Sun Wukong's deck is sheet 176 (CardIDs 17600-17629, the 30 playing cards; the character card is 320 on sheet 3) like Medusa's, the turtles', Doctor Strange's, Eredin's and the rest: only deck.identity tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

No GUID is shared with another hero (tests/test_hero_sun_wukong_data.py).
